title: Rivergraph Studio
description: Build streamgraph, stacked-area, and ridgeline charts from live or imported data — brush to zoom, export PNG/CSV, and share a link.
concept: A multi-series time-series chart studio with three renderer modes (streamgraph, stacked area, ridgeline/joyplot) over four curated datasets or your own CSV import. Drag to brush-zoom a time range, hover for a value tooltip, tune smoothing and color theme, then export the chart as PNG, the data as CSV, or copy a share link that encodes the full dataset and view.
features: 3 chart render modes: streamgraph, stacked area, ridgeline
4 built-in datasets plus a seeded random-walk generator with adjustable series count and volatility
Drag-to-zoom time brushing with hover tooltip and guideline
5 color themes and adjustable curve smoothing
Shareable link that encodes dataset + view in the URL hash
localStorage autosave of dataset, mode, theme, and smoothing

interaction.mouse: Drag across the chart to brush-zoom a time range; hover to see per-series values
interaction.click: Mode buttons switch chart type; swatches switch theme; gear icon toggles the control panel
interaction.touch: Drag to brush-zoom; tap the gear icon to open controls (panel is collapsed by default on phones)
interaction.keyboard: Standard tab/enter navigation on all form controls
